tldr: Venus through the 1st house brings focus to self, body, identity, and first moves.
body: Venus transiting the 1st house softens self, body, identity, and first moves. For about three to four weeks, ease, attraction, value, pleasure, and relational support move through this part of life, making it harder to ignore what needs attention here. This is a receiving transit: it can bring support, pleasure, repair, and opportunities to value this area with more grace.
business: Venus supports personal presence: make the call, update the plan, handle the visible task, and let the transit move something practical.
shadow: Avoidance, indulgence, people-pleasing, or over-identifying with the moment.
advice: Receive and refine in the 1st house deliberately. Work with self, body, identity, and first moves without letting the transit run the whole room.
note: Authored from approved project house-transit material.
